php.LBL_LDAP_SERVER_DESC: de ex. ldap://ldap.example.com sau ldaps://ldap.example.com pentru SSL
php.LBL_LDAP_USER_FILTER_DESC:
Aceste filtre se potrivesc intrărilor clasificate ca persoane fără a specifica atributele utilizatorului, cum ar fi `uid`. Le puteți prelungi cu starea utilizatorului sau cu orice altceva aveți nevoie.
Toate condițiile sunt setate în secțiunea AND (&). Caractere cum ar fi & sau | nu sunt permise aici.
Exemple:
-(objectClass=person)
-(objectClass=user)(!(userAccountControl:1.2.840.113556.1.4.803:=2)) doar pentru utilizatorii AD
php.LBL_LDAP_USER_ATTRIBUTE_DESC: de ex. uid sau sAMAccountName pentru AD
php.LBL_LDAP_RECOMMENDED_INFO: We do not recommend selecting users with admin permissions for LDAP authorization. In case of authorization problems there must be a user who is able to log in without LDAP integration.
php.LBL_AZURE_INFO: To enable SSO, you must set redirect URI in the Azure portal
php.LBL_AZURE_BASE_USER_TOOLTIP:
Selecting a base user will enable automatic user creation. This means that whenever a person logs in with Azure for the first time, a new user will be created in the CRM.

The new user will copy all account details of the base user, except for personal information.

NOTE: It is discouraged to pick admin users as base users, as this will give all new users admin permissions.
